class.name: Netw
class.brief_description: Static entry points for the Networked API.

method.name: action
method.description: Creates a [NetwAction] whose server callback is [param authority]. Call it on every peer, including the server. Repeated calls return the same object. See [NetwAction] for requests and prediction.

method.name: channel
method.description: A [NetwChannel] for sending raw bytes in batches. [param channel_id] runs from [code]100[/code] to [code]254[/code]. [codeblock] var voice := Netw.channel(self, 100) voice.broadcast(frame, false) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_admission
method.description: Declares the session's admission handler and returns its [NetwAdmissionConfig]. The server calls [param handler] with each [NetwJoinRequest] and admits the peer when it returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. The handler may [code]await[/code] for up to [member NetwMultiplayer.auth_timeout].

method.name: configure_clock
method.description: [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_clock(self) \ .ticks_per_second(60) \ .display_offset_ticks(2) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_database
configure_despawn
method.description: Declares what the other peers do with [param node] when [method despawn] removes it. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_despawn(self).linger(0.5) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_entity
method.description: Declares [param node] as a root before it enters the tree. A node placed in a scene that every peer opens needs no [method spawn]. Every peer finds it by its path from [member NetwSession.root], and a peer that does not have it reports it by name and path. [method NetwEntity.of] finds an existing [NetwEntity].

method.name: configure_join
method.description:
Declares what the server does with each peer that joins. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_join(spawn_at)
func spawn_at(who: NetwPlayer, point: StringName, team: int) -> void: arena.add_child(Netw.spawn_player(who, make_avatar, team)) [/codeblock] [param handler] receives the [NetwPlayer], then the arguments the client passed to [method prepare_join] after its username. The username is [member NetwPlayer.username]. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: configure_lagcomp
method.description: [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_lagcomp(self).input_gate_deadline(16) [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_persistence
method.description: [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"gold").persisted() Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .table(&"players") \ .record_id(account_name) [/codeblock] Reach the saved record through [member NetwEntity.persistence].

method.name: configure_property
method.description: For a property supplied by [method Object._get], provide its type through [method Object._get_property_list] or [param declared_type].

method.name: configure_rpc
configure_scene
method.description: Makes [param node] a multiplayer scene. Players only see its children while they are in it. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_scene(self).labeled(&"Arena") [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_schema
method.description:
[codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3(&"pos") static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
@onready var mobs: NetwTable = Netw.session(self).table(&"Mob") [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_server_info
method.description:
Declares what this server says about itself when another peer probes it with [method NetwEndpoint.probe]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_server_info(server_info)
func server_info(info: NetwServerInfo) -> NetwServerInfo: info.motd = "Friday night session" info.max_players = 8 return info [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_session
method.description: [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_session(self).app(&"my-game") [/codeblock]

method.name: configure_signal
method.description: By default, only the node's multiplayer authority may emit [param sig]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_signal(exploded) [/codeblock] Emitting it also fires local listeners. [NetwMemberConfig] controls delivery and who may emit it.

method.name: configure_spawn
configure_transfer
despawn
method.description: Removes the node [method spawn] or [method spawn_player] made, on every peer. [codeblock] Netw.despawn(bullet) [/codeblock] Despawning the root of a [NetwScene] removes the scene at once, with everything in it. See [NetwDespawnOpts] for [param opts]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] for a node that was not spawned, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] outside a session. A client can call it when its player is the [member NetwEntity.controller] and [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] is [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. The node is removed on that client at once, and comes back if the server refuses.

method.name: emit_entity_signal
method.description:
Emits [param sig] on every peer, including the local one, with the arguments that follow. [codeblock] signal exploded(position: Vector2)
func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_signal(self.exploded)
# ...
Netw.emit_entity_signal(self.exploded, position) [/codeblock] Do not also call [code]sig.emit()[/code], or local listeners fire twice.

method.name: of
method.description: Returns the [member Node.multiplayer] of [param node] as a [NetwMultiplayer], for advanced use. A node that is in no tree returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: prepare_join
method.description: Joins the game as [param username]. The arguments after [param username] are passed to the [method configure_join] handler. [codeblock] Netw.prepare_join(self, &"Dev", &"red") multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock] Call it before assigning [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer]. The join can still be refused later, which emits [signal NetwSession.join_failed]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the join will be sent ┠╴ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE the session is already online ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER username is empty ┖╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED node is not inside a session [/codeblock] [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: reparent
method.description: Moves [param node] under [param new_parent] like [method Node.reparent]. The promise resolves once the server has moved it. Other peers move it after. [codeblock] await Netw.reparent(avatar, level2.get_node(^"Players")).wait() [/codeblock] A level keeps its [NetwScene], its viewers and every [member NetwPlayer.scene] when it moves. For a level made with [method NetwSceneConfig.isolated], pass the node [method spawn] returned or the level's root, and the node [method spawn] returned moves. Unlike [method Node.reparent], it does not fire [Area3D] and [Area2D] enter and exit signals during the move, which works around [url=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/14578]this issue[/url]. An overlap that really changed during the move is reported after it with the body and area enter and exit signals, and the shape signals are not sent for it. Otherwise [method Node.reparent] works fine. The promise fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param node] has no entity, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] outside a session. A client can call it when its player is the [member NetwEntity.controller] and [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] is [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. The node moves on that client at once, and moves back if the server refuses.

method.name: request
request_all
request_controller
method.description: Calls [param callable] on the peer of the node's [member NetwEntity.controller], and on the server when no peer steers it. The promise fails at once when the node is not part of a spawned [NetwEntity]. The method may [code]await[/code], as for [method request].

method.name: request_id
method.description: Calls [param callable] on [param peer_id] and returns a [NetwPromise] with its return value. Use [method request_all] to call every peer. The promise fails at once when the node is not part of a spawned [NetwEntity]. The method may [code]await[/code], as for [method request].

method.name: rewind
rpc
method.description: Calls [param callable] on every peer that can see the node. The node must be part of a spawned [NetwEntity]. [codeblock] Netw.rpc(turret.aim, yaw) [/codeblock]

method.name: rpc_controller
method.description: Calls [param callable] on the peer of the node's [member NetwEntity.controller], and on the server when no peer steers it. The node must be part of a spawned [NetwEntity].

method.name: rpc_id
method.description: Calls [param callable] on [param peer_id], or on every peer when [code]0[/code]. The node must be part of a spawned [NetwEntity].

method.name: sample
scene
session
method.description: The [NetwSession] of the [member Node.multiplayer], or [code]null[/code] before [param node] enters the tree. It holds the players, the signals and [member NetwSession.connection], which finds servers and joins or hosts one. [codeblock] var s := Netw.session(self) s.entered.connect(on_entered) s.exited.connect(on_exited) [/codeblock]

method.name: spawn
method.description: Calls [param fn] with the arguments after it on every peer, and returns the node it made here. Add the node before the next tick, under a node every peer has. [codeblock] muzzle.add_child(Netw.spawn(make_bullet, direction)) [/codeblock] Register [param fn] with [method configure_spawn] first. A player who joins later calls [param fn] too, with the same arguments. The node outlives every player. [method spawn_player] makes one that is despawned with its player. A client can call it when the node sets [member NetwEntity.lifecycle] to [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER]. That client's player becomes its [member NetwEntity.controller]. The client sees it at once and loses it if the server refuses. [param fn] returns without waiting. Use [method spawn_async] when it awaits.

method.name: spawn_async
spawn_player
method.description:
Like [method spawn], and writes [member NetwEntity.player] on the node [param fn] returns. The two lines below spawn the same entity. [codeblock] players.add_child(Netw.spawn_player(player, make_avatar)) players.add_child(Netw.spawn(make_avatar_of, player.peer_id))
func make_avatar_of(peer_id: int) -> Node: var avatar := make_avatar() var who := Netw.session(self).player_of(peer_id) NetwEntity.of(avatar).player = who return avatar [/codeblock] Returns [code]null[/code] and spawns nothing when the session does not hold [param player]. The node is despawned when [param player] leaves. With [method NetwPersistenceConfig.load_on_spawn], other peers receive it once its save is loaded. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: sync_property
method.description: Sends the current value of [param property] to the other peers. Use it for a property that changes rarely. [codeblock] func refuel() -> void: fuel = 100.0 Netw.sync_property(self, &"fuel") [/codeblock] Call [method configure_property] first.
